levels.RPZ0: collision-aware reference token or coordinate; not a definition
levels.RPZ1: canonical candidate name, bound term, slug, acronym, renderings, and aliases
levels.RPZ2: intension or one-hop essence sufficient to distinguish the object in context
levels.RPZ3: thick definition and relational manifold with typed adjacency, qualifications, standing, and provenance
levels.RPZ4+: generated traversal or exposition compiled on demand and labeled as synthesis

levels.SZ2: semantic indexes, catalogs, and universal GSM
levels.SZ3: full papers, codices, specifications, evidence, and revision dossiers
